new_deal_candidates.buyer: Apollo Global Management, via Eagle Bidco
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: easyJet confirms that its board agreed on August 6, 2026, to recommend Apollo’s cash acquisition offer. The scheme document deadline was extended to October 15, 2026, so the transaction remains pending.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: easyJet does not appear in the supplied known deals or candidate list; the announcement is outside the 30-day priority window but remains an active, material takeover proposal.
